title: Modern Retractable Wall Hook - 2-1/2 Inch Pull-Out, Wall Mount Brass Bathroom Hook (15 Lb Capacity), Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels and robes within reach without cluttering your bathroom wall—this modern retractable wall hook pulls out when you need it and pushes back in when you don’t. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s a clean, space-saving choice for modern bathroom hardware.

  • Creates instant hanging space in tight bathrooms with a 2-1/2" pull-out rod
  • Keeps a crisp, minimalist look by retracting back into the wall when not in use
  • Holds up to 15 lb for daily-use towels, robes, and clothing
  • Personalizes your look: remove the included knob tip and swap in a cabinet knob of your choice
  • Brass construction for an enduring, modern finish presence

Why it’s different: Unlike mass-market alternatives, this retractable hook uses brass construction and a space-saving wall-mounted design built for everyday bathrooms.

Specs

  • Product type: Retractable wall hook
  • Hanging space (pull-out): 2-1/2" (2.5")
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 2" x 2" x 3.75"

  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Lifetime warranty
